admission_sequence: Review the concrete operational contract and exact citation/source-role bindings; commit an additive used-source protocol before any DAT acquisition. External expert review may remain pending and is not a new implementation/intake gate.
Acquire native DAT with ordinary public requests, bounded transport, immutable originalbytes/hash/size/retrieval/redirect/rights receipts, no overwrite or account bypass. HEAD is not raw receipt.
Independently admit rawpins, then execute separately scoped framing/ASCII preflight before selected-value decoding; unresolved framing stops with metadata-only failure, no repairs/outcomes.

Implement selected pure adapter and diagnostics using syntheticfixtures only; independently admit actual loaded parser/diagnostic/helper code hashes and source identities before first selected empirical run.

Run complete private ledger and nominal diagnostic only after source/codeadmission; apply approved output allowlist/privacy guard; freeze aggregate report and run offline exactreplay without mutable self-repin shortcuts.

estimand.age_rule: MXPAXTMR>=240 using1080+ lower bound; no interview/ADULT-age substitution
estimand.assay_rule: Eligible and both native reference assays supported and strictlypositive => qualifying_pair. No screening/treatment eligibility; not treatment-free.
estimand.clause_logic: Evaluate all available clauses before disposition. Any knownfalse => excluded by first false clause. Otherwise anyunknown => unknown by first unknown clause. Only alltrue => eligible. Missing links propagate unknown fields, never zero.
estimand.clock_rule: Diagnostic is nominal/source-role repeat-label persistence; MXPRDAYS is not an eligibility clause or elapsed-biological clock. Partition every qualifying pair privately into positive recorded exam days, none_never00 or blankunknown; retain untimed pairs. No timed-subset result, timestamp or hazard.
estimand.procedure_context: Declare inference from producer reference-FPG procedure scope and known source session roles. It does not prove independently observed per-record location, exact date or actual draw session.
estimand.question: Does a threshold-positive first source-labelled reference FPG necessarily remain threshold-positive in its linked designated repeat record, within the declared finite source subset?
estimand.source_subset_not_paper_reproduction: FPG-only/HAD1No; no A1c completeness or unreproduced pregnancy-history exclusion, and no tuning to publication cohort or outcomes.
estimand.universe: Released LABSE records with unique exact source keys; primary and adult linkage inspected privately. Not an invitation frame.

operational_authority: Exact public-source acquisition may proceed after this protocol is committed. Only framing metadata may be audited after independent raw admission. Selected empirical decoding/diagnostics require independently admitted loaded code and registered fixed definitions first.

private_diagnostic.contradicted: At least one qualifying first-positive/repeat-negative pair.
private_diagnostic.not_contradicted_in_observed_pairs: Positive support with no observed counterexample. This is not validation, confirmation or error-rate identification.
private_diagnostic.not_evaluable: No qualifying pairs OR no first-positive support. No vacuous pass.

private_ledger.key_storage: Opaque lexemes/private records in memory only; no debug repr, output, database, joined file or persistent record cache.
private_ledger.rule: A missing link is not an orphan structural error; it remains explicit unknown unless another known false excludes the record. Extra primary/ADULT records are outside the repeat frame. Do not collapse, trim or delete rows to clear eligibility/privacy. Overlapping clause coverage is not added as people. Link counts are nonadditive coverage; assign exactly one mutuallyexclusive final disposition per repeat record after all available clause checks.

public_output_proposal.delete_one_comparison: Compare unredacted internal diagnostic statuses before any privacy transformation. Do not recursively apply withholding during deletion comparisons.
public_output_proposal.minimality: Uses singleton and individual-sensitivity logic rather than an arbitrary larger cell minimum. Logical constants0/1 are fixed method definitions, not empirical/clinical effects. No labelled paired tuples are ever published, even in large cells.
never_export: Labelled paired cells, witness examples or marginal/conditional counts
Any qualifying/support/counterexample count, histogram or reason for withheld status
Private ledger counts/reasons or positive-support flags
Sex/age or other subgroups that split the source cohort
Absolute local paths or private source errors
public_output_proposal.privacy_candidate: Compute complete internal result first. Publicstatus=withheld whenever eligible_count==1, any nonempty private qualifying-pair label cell has cardinality1, or removing any one qualifying pair changes the internal status. Apply this to all internal statuses, including not_evaluable. No withheld reason, support, counts, cells, margins, histogram or subgroup output. Otherwise publish only the internal coarse status. Keep all records/ledgers unchanged.
public_output_proposal.unresolved_before_freeze: No extra external signoff gate. This deterministic rule implements singleton and individual-sensitivity withholding for the fixed pooled schema. It is limited disclosure control, not differential privacy or blanket anonymity against other public records. Broader scientific review remains separate from permitted implementation/evidence collection.

record_adapter_policy.decimal_lexeme: After ASCII-space trimming and exact88888 missing decode, [0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)? only. No implied divide-by10 from display FORMAT. Signs, exponents, SAS dot/special-missing syntax, commas and other undocumented lexemes refuse pending additive admission; no guessed interpretation.
record_adapter_policy.encoding: ASCII bytes; no BOM, NUL, tabs, DOS EOF marker or other undocumented control/non-ASCII bytes. Scan framing without decoding unselected field contents.
record_adapter_policy.final_record: Permit exactly one unterminated final record only if it satisfies the same admitted selected-prefix and maximum-width constraints; never append bytes to raw source.
record_adapter_policy.integer_lexeme: After ASCII-space trimming, [0-9]+ only in native integer fields. Empty token is source blank. Any other syntax refuses with sanitized field-role error.
record_adapter_policy.line_endings: Uniform CRLF or uniform LF, preserved in raw archive. BareCR, mixed newline forms and internal blank records refuse. One terminal separator is not a blank data record.
record_adapter_policy.numeric_limits: No producer observed minimum/maximum is a parser or biological bound. Physical field width is structural. Negative/unsupported syntax is refused, not turned into absence or an outcome.
record_adapter_policy.row_length: Require minimum_selected_prefix_width <= actual data bytes <= producer_data_max_width_excluding_newline. Omitted unselected suffix allowed as an explicit selected-field policy, not proof the native download uses variable-length rows. No selected-field padding/truncation.
record_adapter_policy.selected_projection: Exactly the declared fields; no weights, dates, assays, pregnancy, screening, medication or free-text fields beyond this projection.
record_adapter_policy.seqn: Strip only external ASCIIspaces from the5-byte field; require [0-9]+, preserve leadingzero lexeme and original bytes privately. Exactlexeme linkage; never floatcoerce or silently merge numeric-looking aliases. Check duplicate exactkeys and numeric-looking aliases only for integrity: same numeric value with distinct zero spellings triggers sanitized unresolved-key-format refusal before diagnostics, not an automatic join. Ordinary unmatched keys remain unknown coverage.
record_adapter_policy.source_semantics_limit: Producer MISSOVER is not a mandate for this adapter. Any observed unsupported framing stops before selected-value decoding; retain raw and metadata-only failure receipt. Do not infer framing or participant counts from HEAD lengths.
record_adapter_policy.space_padding: Preserve all original file bytes. ASCIIspaces inside native fields are source padding and are stripped only at selected-field ends; never synthesize or pad a short selected field. No rewrite of raw line endings or EOF.

restriction_disposition: Proposal-only acquisition/implementation restriction superseded by the bounded operational authority. All clinical, national, causal and release restrictions retained.
restrictions: No latent-state mapping, clinical confirmation, T2D-subtype claim, measurement-error identification, causal dietary effect, annualization, population weights, mortality process or national transport.

review_dispositions.definitions: Accepted cited analyst-selected 20-year, 8-hour and 126-mg/dL criteria, with no publisher-byte-replay claim. Register benchmark definitions before empirical diagnostics; source topcode is producer-documented.
review_dispositions.framing: Accepted explicit selected-prefix adapter policy; actual native framing remains unverified until source admission and framing-only audit. Stop on deviations, preserve failure, use additive amendment without repairs.
review_dispositions.missingness: Accepted separate known failure/unknown eligibility, unlisted context/history handling and declared strictly-positive assay availability; zero fasting is a known short fast.
review_dispositions.privacy: Accepted exact pooled allowlist and singleton/private-cell/delete-one-unredacted-status predicate. No count/reason exports, trimming or extra approval gate; no anonymity guarantee.
review_dispositions.scientific_assessment: Research-backed source and contract appraisal assisted by automated author/reviewer/root checks. No independent human clinical assessment; external expert review pending. Benchmark-only implementation is permitted; no scientific blocker closed.

paper.role: Previously inspected publication criteria and source-supported analyst-selected diagnostic definitions; no publisher raw pin or independent byte reproduction claimed.

source_integrity_policy.content_encoding: Missing or identity only; otherwise controlledstop pending separate transport admission.
source_integrity_policy.fetch: Ordinary exactproducer URLs, explicit online acquisition only after committedprotocol, response200, no account/cookie/challenge workaround, no overwrite, receiptlast. Native DAT only, no guessedZIP/gzip conversion.
source_integrity_policy.framing_audit: After rawpins admitted, examine only framing/charset/length metadata before selected-value decoding. No participant keys/assays/records or row locations in failure receipts. Outsidepolicy=>stop, not normalization.
source_integrity_policy.limit_role: 128MiB transport cap, not source fact, participantcount or model parameter. HEAD lengths do not supply rawpins.
source_integrity_policy.loaded_code_admission: Independently admit actual loaded wrapper/parser/diagnostic and reused helper origins/hashes before empiricaldiagnostic. Equivalent bytes from other installed paths accepted only after actual loaded-file verification, stable moduleIDs in public provenance.
source_integrity_policy.offline: No network or mutable self-repin; changed protocol/source/code pin, role/gate/schema, unexpected extra component or duplicateJSONkey fails before parsing/diagnostics.
source_integrity_policy.raw_admission: Before parsing, independently pin each originalpayload SHA256,size,retrieval and redirect receipt; exactbytes immutable. Originalmetadata and priorregistry keyeddefinitions remain unchanged.
